title: Particles, Antiparticles, Quarks and Leptons
topicTitle: Particle physics: particles and antiparticles, quarks (baryons and mesons) and leptons (neutrinos)
notes: **Elementary particles:** particles with no known internal structure. They are the building blocks of matter and force carriers.
**Antiparticles:** every particle has a corresponding antiparticle with the same mass but opposite charge. Electron's antiparticle is the positron ($e^+$).

**Quarks:** fundamental constituents of hadrons. Six flavours: up, down, charm, strange, top, bottom. Quarks combine to form baryons (three quarks, e.g., proton = uud) and mesons (quark-antiquark pairs).
**Leptons:** fundamental particles that do not feel the strong force. Six types: electron, muon, tau, and their corresponding neutrinos. Neutrinos interact only via weak force and gravity.
**Standard Model:** classifies all known elementary particles into fermions (quarks and leptons, which make up matter) and bosons (force carriers: photon, gluon, W/Z, Higgs).
